text:
matt: Heads-up — planning a schema migration on user_events that takes an exclusive LOCK on each shard for ~1-3s. Target change window Wed 03:00 UTC (4h maintenance window). Need a service version pin for events-consumer and a deploybot holdpoint. Full plan below.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: migration/user_events/2026-06-18 at 2026-06-18T03:00Z. Holdpoint requested. (hp-request-id: req-402)

priya: can you paste the exact ALTER? want to run a quick preflight locally.

matt: ```sql
BEGIN;
ALTER TABLE user_events ADD COLUMN event_type varchar(64) DEFAULT 'generic' NOT NULL;
-- backfill will be done in small batches after column add to avoid long locks
COMMIT;
```

nick: +1 on pinning. Request pin events-consumer -> image: events-consumer:v2.4.1 for the window. Rollback plan if we see errors: 1) flip feature flag event-type-enabled -> off, 2) pin back to events-consumer:v2.4.0, 3) run backfill resume with rate-limit if needed. Also recommend keeping canary at 5% for first 15m.

ops-oncall: I'll watch pg_stat_activity for lock wait >500ms and index scans. I'll attach the watch script to this thread. If lock holds >5s I'll call rollback.

ops-oncall: ```bash
# quick watcher
watch -n 1 "psql -c \"SELECT now(), pid, state, wait_event_type, query FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE query LIKE '%user_events%'\""
```

matt: rollout plan: 1) apply ALTER (fast add column) 2) canary deploy events-consumer:v2.4.1 -> 5% for 15m with holdpoint hp-402 3) run backfill in 30s-batched jobs with row-limiter 4) if metrics OK, release to 100%. Commands I'm going to run:
```bash
./deploy canary --svc events-consumer --image events-consumer:v2.4.1 --percent 5 --holdpoint hp-402
./db/migrations/run_migration.sh user_events add_event_type --lock-quiet-window=1s
```

deploy-bot: holdpoint created: hp-402 (owner: matt). Webhook: https://deploys.internal/holdpoints/hp-402. Canary start scheduled in 10m.

priya: LGTM — I'll run preflight on staging in ~20m and paste results here.

ops-oncall: I'll set an alert: PG_LOCK_WAIT > 3s -> pager. Also watching 95th perc latency for events-consumer. :eyes:

sara: small nit for release notes: include "Add event_type (varchar, default 'generic') to user_events; backfill batched to avoid locks". I'll add a line to CHANGELOG.

matt: thanks — will add to release notes and include rollback steps. If anyone sees anything odd during canary ping @ops-oncall and @matt. :thumbsup:

priya: preflight passed on staging (no long locks, backfill run smoke ok). Ready to proceed on the scheduled window.

nick: standing by for the pin. After canary approve, I'll push pin via infra-tooling.

matt: done — infra pin queued. Final: holdpoint hp-402 active, canary scheduled, rollback plan in runbook.

deploy-bot: action log: req-402 -> hp-402 created by matt at 1765123459.

sara: noted in CHANGELOG and release notes updated.

matt: cool, thanks everyone. I'll post a short post-mortem if anything goes awry.
